subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared, persisted `/stream` command and the `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability as a supported plugin contract for Telegram, Discord, and Slack?
rationale: This choice defines a durable shared plugin capability and a session-persistence behavior; it cannot be resolved safely as a mechanical correction to the contributor branch.

options.title: Adopt the shared contract
options.body: Approve the capability and session override as a supported cross-channel feature, contingent on refreshed runtime proof and merge-head validation.

options.title: Narrow to an owner plugin
options.body: Keep the session-command idea but move it into a channel-specific owner boundary until a broader plugin contract is designed.

options.title: Decline persisted overrides
options.body: Close the feature direction and retain channel configuration as the sole streaming-mode control.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared contract
recommendation.body: Approve the capability and session override as a supported cross-channel feature, contingent on refreshed runtime proof and merge-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed adjacent contributor in the supplied context for the preview/progress user-experience boundary; ownership confidence remains low.
